text:
anya: Quick sync — proposing a phased rollout pattern for the upcoming GA: Phase A (internal + 2 pilot customers, 0.5% traffic), Phase B (early access, 10%), Phase C (general availability). Thoughts on SLA differences per phase?
sam: Love the phases. We should keep a hard SLO for phase C (GA): p50 < 100ms, p95 < 300ms for text-gen API. Phase A/B can have relaxed targets but must have rollback windows.
maria: +1. Also need explicit support commitments per phase. Phase A: weekday 9–5 EMEA/US; Phase B: 24/5; Phase C: 24/7 oncall with guaranteed response times for Sev1/2.
jordan: Can we codify the fallback policy in the rollout doc? If Dedicated capacity is saturated we fallback to compatible smaller model, and for GA we require autoscale headroom of at least 25%.
ops-bot: deploy-canary: Canary deployment started for service: inference-api on c1 (~1% of traffic). Link: <https://console.redwood/ops/deploys/9876>
anya: Good call on fallback. Let's add explicit metrics that must be green before promoting between phases: error rate < 0.5%, latency SLOs met, CPU/GPU saturation < 70% for 10m window, and no P0 incidents opened in last 24h.
sam: Documentation checklist: public API spec, rate limits table, example SDK snippets, migration notes for older clients, pricing FAQ. Who owns each doc?
maria: I'll own the public API spec + migration notes. @jordan handle rate limits + pricing FAQ?
jordan: I can do rate limits and a draft pricing FAQ. Need input from finance on burst pricing buckets.
anya: Monitoring/alerts: add synthetic smoke tests (per-region), token-usage budget alerts per-customer, and prompt-regression alerts tied to evals. Alert playbooks need to include suggested mitigations (throttle, fallback model, disable features).
ops-bot: alert-config check: Synthetic checks present in us-east and eu-west. Token budget alerts not configured for pilot customers yet.
maria: Support readiness: create a 2-week burn-in for pilot customers with CS handholding. Create a short runbook for common failures and standard replies templates.
sam: Commercial: for phase B early access we need a minimum commitment clause (3 months) for reserved capacity offers. Finance will provide pricing tiers by tomorrow.
anya: Can we add a list of non-blocking stretch goals vs blocking GA criteria? Example: inlined function-calling support = stretch; SLA, docs, monitoring, support runbooks = blocking. Let's capture that in the launch doc.
jordan: I'll create a PR to the launch playbook with explicit gating criteria and the checklist items. Will add owners and 'must pass' flag.
maria: FYI — legal asked for a data residency note for EU pilots. We need KMS/HSM integration options documented for Private deployments.
anya: Good catch. Add a clause: EU pilot customers can opt into EU-only region and storage.
sam: Risk register quick items: capacity oversubscription, cost runaway for embeddings heavy workloads, prompt regressions after model tweak. Mitigations: conservative canary percentages, auto-throttle by token budget, rollback automation.
ops-bot: rollup: action items captured in the playbook PR assigned to owners. Canary running; monitoring baseline collecting for next 2h.
anya: OK team — next check-in in 24h. For now: owners listed, docs assigned, metrics to verify before phase promos. Add anything else to the PR and ping me. :thumbsup:
